questions.stem: How can stem cells from plants (meristem tissue) be used?

options.text: To treat human diseases such as diabetes
To produce large numbers of genetically identical plants quickly and cheaply
To create new species of plants that have never existed
To replace damaged organs in humans

questions.explanation: Plant meristem cells can differentiate throughout the plant's life. They can be used to produce clones of plants with desirable characteristics quickly and cheaply, which is valuable for agriculture and horticulture.
